# Awesome Genesis [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)

A curated list of open-source projects, wrappers, and research that use the **Genesis** simulator — the high-performance generative physics engine for robotics and embodied AI.

This list highlights projects that explicitly mention or integrate Genesis in their README or documentation, with **≥ 10 GitHub stars**.

Contributions welcome! Please open an issue or PR to add more resources.

---

## 🧭 Official / Core Resources

* [**Genesis-Embodied-AI/Genesis**](https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/Genesis) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Genesis-Embodied-AI/Genesis) — Core engine, renderer, and examples.
* [Genesis Documentation](https://genesis-embodied-ai.github.io/) — Official docs, API, and tutorials.

---

## ⭐ Projects & Wrappers

* [**huggingface/gym-genesis**](https://github.com/huggingface/gym-genesis) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/huggingface/gym-genesis) — Gym wrapper for Genesis environments.
* [**lupinjia/genesis_lr**](https://github.com/lupinjia/genesis_lr) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/lupinjia/genesis_lr) — Legged robot RL environments supporting Genesis & IsaacGym.
* [**aCodeDog/genesis_legged_gym**](https://github.com/aCodeDog/genesis_legged_gym) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/aCodeDog/genesis_legged_gym) — Legged_gym-style environments implemented in Genesis.
* [**vybhav-ibr/genesis_ros**](https://github.com/vybhav-ibr/genesis_ros) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/vybhav-ibr/genesis_ros) — ROS2 bridge to connect Genesis and ROS2.
* [**aCodeDog/OmniPerception**](https://github.com/aCodeDog/OmniPerception) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/aCodeDog/OmniPerception) — Omni-directional LiDAR / sensor sim supporting Genesis, IsaacGym, Mujoco, IsaacSim.
* [**Genesis-Embodied-AI/DiffTactile**](https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/DiffTactile) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Genesis-Embodied-AI/DiffTactile) — Differentiable tactile simulator built on Genesis (ICLR 2024).
* [**BarisYazici/libfranka-sim**](https://github.com/BarisYazici/libfranka-sim) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/BarisYazici/libfranka-sim) — Franka/libfranka-compatible simulator backend powered by Genesis.
* [**alexis779/slobot**](https://github.com/alexis779/slobot) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/alexis779/slobot) — SO-ARM-100 robotic arm experiments using Genesis.
* [**RoboVerseOrg/RoboVerse**](https://github.com/RoboVerseOrg/RoboVerse) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/RoboVerseOrg/RoboVerse) — Unified robot learning platform & benchmark. Genesis is one of the supported backends.
* [**Genesis-Embodied-AI/RoboGen**](https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/RoboGen) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Genesis-Embodied-AI/RoboGen) — Generative, self-guided robotic agent pipeline powered by Genesis.
* [**severian42/Proteus-The-Genesis-LLM**](https://github.com/severian42/Proteus-The-Genesis-LLM) ![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/severian42/Proteus-The-Genesis-LLM) — Experimental platform combining LLMs with Genesis physics.

---

## 📚 Research & Papers

* **RoboGen** — *RoboGen: Towards Unleashing Infinite Data for Automated Robot Learning via Generative Simulation* (ICML 2024).
* **DiffTactile** — Differentiable tactile simulation (ICLR 2024).
